Title: How to start with Azure Data Explorer—A new online course

Body.Content:
A new online course that offers a comprehensive overview of data analytics with Azure Data Explorer is now available for free.

Azure Data Explorer is a fully managed, near-real-time (NRT) analytic solution for big data that includes many capabilities such as analytics queries, time series, machine learning, geo spatial, and integration with many other services. 

Register here for free access to the course.
